body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within natural weapon range. On a success, deal 1 Slashing damage; if the target is already wounded, deal +1 damage.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense from concealment or cover for this Action.
Ignore the next die you would burn because of a damage Condition before your next turn.

rider.title: PREDATOR ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Razor Form. While maintained: Your natural weapons gain +1 reach while you move toward an enemy at least once each turn.
